title: BBQ Chicken Bowls
subtitle: Built bowls, big flavor, one line
description: Sweet smoke, rice base, everyone eats happy.
equipment: Large cast iron skillet or Dutch oven

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice (simmer, 18 min): Fluffy rice in the steamer or pot; hold warm.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Grill BBQ chicken (medium-high, 18 min): Grill thighs, glaze with sauce last 5 min; 165°F internal.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Warm corn (medium, 6 min): Butter-season corn; hold on the line.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Toss slaw (no heat, 5 min): Dress coleslaw; keep cold. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Run bowl line (serve): Rice, chicken, corn, slaw — crew builds bowls.

proTips: Glaze sauce at the end so it doesn't burn on the grill.
Keep slaw on ice under the counter.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold protein after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
Pull chicken at 160°F and let carryover hit 165°F — dry breast ruins crew morale.
tonightSpread: Build bowls base → grain → protein → toppings so the line moves in one direction.
Put hot components closest to the crew, cold crunch at the far end.
Line up BBQ Chicken Bowls on the main counter with serving spoons — firefighters grab fast between calls.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven at 200°F for late arrivals after a run.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
